description: This file defines the Zend_Uri_Http class, which extends Zend_Uri to handle HTTP-specific URI parsing, validation, and construction within the Zend Framework. It manages URI components such as username, password, host, port, path, query, and fragment, providing methods for validation, getters, setters, and URI assembly.

classes.name: Zend_Uri_Http
classes.description: A class for handling HTTP URIs, including parsing, validation, and construction of URI strings with components like username, password, host, port, path, query, and fragment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the URI object with a scheme and optional scheme-specific part, parsing components and validating the URI.

methods.name: _parseUri
methods.description: Parses the scheme-specific part of the URI into its components: path, query, fragment, username, password, host, and port.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full URI string from the components, validating before assembly.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Validates all URI components to ensure they conform to expected formats.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username component or false if not set.

methods.name: validateUsername
methods.description: Validates the username against allowed characters.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username component after validation, returning the old value.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password component or false if not set.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Validates the password against allowed characters, considering the presence of username.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password component after validation, returning the old value.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host component or false if not set.

methods.name: validateHost
methods.description: Validates the host component using Zend_Validate_Hostname.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the host component after validation, returning the old value.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port component or false if not set.

methods.name: validatePort
methods.description: Validates the port to be a number between 1 and 65535.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the port component after validation, returning the old value.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path component or '/' if not set.

methods.name: validatePath
methods.description: Validates the path component against a regex pattern.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the path component after validation, returning the old value.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the query component or false if not set.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates the query string against a regex pattern.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the query component, accepting strings or arrays, validating the result.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment component or false if not set.

methods.name: validateFragment
methods.description: Validates the fragment against a regex pattern.

methods.name: setFragment
methods.description: Sets the fragment component after validation, returning the old value.
